cases.sentence: Так говорит Господь, Бог Израиля, «Пойди к Цедекии, царю ___, и скажи ему».
cases.translation: Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, 'Go, and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah.'
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession: царь Иуды means 'king of Judah.'

cases.sentence: Я отдаю этот город в руки царя Вавилона, и он сожжет его, и ты не спасешься от ___ его.
cases.translation: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon and he will burn it with fire.
cases.explain: The genitive case is required after the preposition 'от' (from): от руки means 'from the hand.'

cases.sentence: Ты увидишь царя Вавилона собственными ___ и он будет разговаривать с тобой лицом к лицу.
cases.translation: Your eyes will see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he will speak with you mouth to mouth.
cases.explain: The instrumental case is required for means: собственными глазами means 'with your own eyes.'

cases.sentence: И как устраивали поминальный костер в честь твоих предков, прежних ___, которые были до тебя, так разведут костер и в твою честь.
cases.translation: And as they made a burning for your fathers, the former kings who were before you, so they will make a burning for you.
cases.explain: The genitive plural is required after 'прежних' (former): прежних царей means 'former kings.'

cases.sentence: Я заключил завет с вашими предками, когда я вывел их из Египта, из земли ___.
cases.translation: I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
cases.explain: The genitive case is required after the preposition 'из' (from): из земли рабства means 'from the land of bondage.'

cases.sentence: Они согласились и отпустили их, но потом передумали, вернули назад рабов, которых они отпустили, и снова обратили их в ___.
cases.translation: They obeyed and let them go, but afterwards they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids to return, and brought them into bondage.
cases.explain: The accusative case is required for the object of the verb 'обратили' (brought): обратили их в рабство.

cases.sentence: Каждый из вас объявил свободу своим соплеменникам в доме, который носит мое ___.
cases.translation: In every man proclaiming liberty to his neighbor. You had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name.
cases.explain: The accusative case is required for the object of the verb 'носит' (bears): дом, который носит мое имя.

cases.sentence: Я отдам Цидекию царя Иудеи и его приближенных их врагам, которые ищут их ___.
cases.translation: I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes into the hands of their enemies, into the hands of those who seek their life.
cases.explain: The genitive case is required after the verb 'ищут' (they seek): ищут их смерти means 'seek their death.'

reading.ru: Пока Новохудоносор, царь Вавилона, все его войска и все царства и народы империи, которой он правил, вели войну с Иерусалимом и всеми окрестными городами, было Иеремии слово Господне.
reading.question: When did the word of the Lord come to Jeremiah?
options: After the siege of Jerusalem ended
During Nebuchadnezzar's campaign against Jerusalem and surrounding cities
While Jeremiah was in the temple
After the kingdom fell to Babylon
reading.correct: During Nebuchadnezzar's campaign against Jerusalem and surrounding cities
reading.explain: The text states that the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah while Nebuchadnezzar and his forces were waging war against Jerusalem and all the surrounding cities.

reading.ru: Ты не спасешься от его руки, но непременно будешь схвачен и отдан ему.
reading.question: What will happen to Zedekiah?
options: He will be captured and delivered into the king's hand
He will hide in the mountains
reading.correct: He will be captured and delivered into the king's hand
reading.explain: Jeremiah tells Zedekiah 'ты не спасешься от его руки, но непременно будешь схвачен и отдан ему' (you will not escape his hand, but will surely be captured and delivered to him).

reading.ru: Но слушай Господне обещание, Цедекия, царь Иудеи, так говорит Господь о тебе, ты не погибнешь от меча, ты умрешь в мире.
reading.question: What does the Lord promise about Zedekiah's death?
options: He will die by the sword in battle
He will not die by the sword but will die in peace
He will be executed by the Babylonians
reading.correct: He will not die by the sword but will die in peace
reading.explain: The Lord tells Zedekiah 'ты не погибнешь от меча, ты умрешь в мире' (you will not die by the sword, you will die in peace).

reading.ru: И было к Иеремии слово Господа. Так говорит Господь, Бог Израиля. «Я заключил завет с вашими предками, когда я вывел их из Египта, из земли рабства.»
reading.question: What covenant did the Lord make with the ancestors?
options: A covenant to conquer all neighboring nations
A covenant made when He brought them out of Egypt from the land of bondage
A covenant about building a great temple
A covenant to give them great riches
reading.correct: A covenant made when He brought them out of Egypt from the land of bondage
reading.explain: The text states 'Я заключил завет с вашими предками, когда я вывел их из Египта, из земли рабства' (I made a covenant with your fathers when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the land of bondage).

reading.ru: Но сейчас вы повернули назад и осквернили мое имя.
reading.question: What have the people done according to the Lord?
options: They have turned back and defiled His name
They have freed all their slaves
reading.correct: They have turned back and defiled His name
reading.explain: The Lord says 'Но сейчас вы повернули назад и осквернили мое имя' (But now you have turned back and profaned my name).

reading.ru: Поэтому так говорит Господь, вы не послушались меня и не объявили свободу своим соплеменникам.
reading.question: What is the Lord's complaint against the people?
options: They have not listened and have not proclaimed liberty to their brothers
They have refused to pay tribute
reading.correct: They have not listened and have not proclaimed liberty to their brothers
reading.explain: The text states 'Поэтому так говорит Господь, вы не послушались меня и не объявили свободу своим соплеменникам' (Therefore the Lord says: you have not listened to me and have not proclaimed liberty to your brothers).
